title: Reproducer Synthesis for AI-Reported Bugs in the Linux Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2611.34142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic review systems are increasingly flagging suspected bugs in Linux kernel patches as textual reports. A maintainer who receives such reports needs further inspection to determine whether the report is true. The inspection requires understanding whether the bug can be triggered and, if necessary, manually constructing one. As a consequence, despite the excessive textual explanation, many reports go unanswered. In this paper, we argue that a runnable proof-of-concept (PoC) is the key information in such AI-generated kernel review reports. It is, however, challenging to automatically synthesize a valid and runnable PoC.   We present ReproCue, a framework that generates PoCs for AI-generated Linux kernel reviews. ReproCue replays the historical kernel bugs and learns one reproduction finite-state-machine (FSM) per subsystem from successful runs. translated_title: 面向 Linux 内核中 AI 报告缺陷的复现程序自动合成
translated_abstract: 智能体审查系统正日益以文本报告的形式标记 Linux 内核补丁中疑似存在的缺陷。收到此类报告的维护者需要进一步检查才能确定报告是否属实。这一检查需要了解该缺陷是否能够被触发，如有必要还需手动构造触发方式。因此，尽管报告中包含大量文字说明，许多报告仍然得不到回应。在本文中，我们认为可运行的验证性测试程序是该类 AI 生成的内核审查报告中的关键信息。然而，自动合成一个有效且可运行的 PoC 是极具挑战性的。我们提出了 ReproCue，一个为 AI 生成的 Linux 内核审查报告生成 PoC 的框架。ReproCue 通过重放历史内核缺陷，从成功运行中为每个子系统学习一个复现有限状态机（FSM）。该 FSM 记录了复现过程所经历的步骤，以及观察到的相关需求条件……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ReproCue 框架通过重放历史内核缺陷并从中学习各子系统的复现有限状态机，为 AI 生成的 Linux 内核缺陷审查报告自动合成有效且可运行的验证程序（PoC），从而帮助维护者快速确认缺陷报告的真实性。
en_tdlr: ReproCue automatically synthesizes valid and runnable proof-of-concept (PoC) programs for AI-generated Linux kernel bug review reports by replaying historical kernel bugs and learning a reproduction finite-state machine per subsystem.
